fact: Region order of completion: ERCOT > PJM > CAISO
outside evidence: LBNL completion rates; naive 5-year mock-up ERCOT 21%, PJM 15%, CAISO 4% (notebook 01)
model evidence: every test request moved to each region: ERCOT 13.4%, PJM 13.9%, CAISO 12.6%

fact: Requests under 20 MW reach operation sooner (FERC small-generator procedures)
outside evidence: LBNL median request→operation: 36 months at 5–20 MW vs 53 at 20–50 MW
model evidence: change at the 20 MW step: ERCOT +1.8 points, PJM +1.4 points, CAISO +0.7 points

fact: Gas completes more often than solar
outside evidence: LBNL completion by count: gas 29.9%, solar 13.4%
model evidence: technology partial dependence, mean of three regions: gas 24.3%, solar 10.7%

fact: Batteries and solar+battery hybrids lag solar
outside evidence: LBNL completion by count: battery 8.2%, solar+battery 9.1%, solar 13.4%

fact: A more crowded queue at entry lowers completion (Johnston, Liu & Yang, 2023)
outside evidence: queue crowding as the mechanism of attrition; F8 of notebook 03
model evidence: partial dependence from the 2nd to the 98th percentile of GW waiting: ERCOT +9.8 points, PJM +7.3 points, CAISO -0.1 points

fact: ERIS and NRIS requests complete at similar rates (within 2 points)
outside evidence: LBNL: ERIS and NRIS requests take similar times to an IA (benchmark of notebook 03)
model evidence: service partial dependence, mean of three regions: ERIS 10.9%, NRIS 12.9%
